attempts.sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
WHERE f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py'
  AND cb.base_name = 'SQLDatabase'
  AND s.kind = 'method'
  AND s.is_public = FALSE
  AND s.has_docstring = FALSE
  AND s.file_id NOT LIKE '%tests/%'
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.name = 'get_columns' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
